prompt: Create one complete freestanding object for a children's 3D factory game. Friendly tactile matte painted plastic/clay, chunky softened edges, simple robust toy geometry, turquoise/teal, warm golden yellow and small coral accents, clean gently varied surface. White studio background, soft even light, no floor or ground plate, no cast-shadow geometry, no text, labels, logos, watermarks or humans. Entire object in frame with margin, front-left three-quarter product view showing front and side. Intended for 4000-triangle image-to-3D reconstruction. A tall compact industrial electrical control cabinet, proportions width1.2 height2.1 depth0.6. Teal rectangular freestanding enclosure with broad golden-yellow CLOSED front door and thick base plinth. On its upper front door EXACTLY THREE clearly separated large circular raised indicator lenses in a horizontal row: red on left, amber in middle, green on right. Each a solid vivid opaque coloured convex puck surrounded by a simple dark teal bezel, no glow or transparency. Wide blank door margin around the three circles, easy to isolate in mesh. Below them a single chunky dark teal handle to one side and two small broad switches. The three lenses must be distinct from the cabinet and from each other; no fourth lamp, no stacked tower, no cables. No interior exposed, no writing.
